text: Program Description The Chinese Language Program offered by the International Department aims to provide international students with a systematic and comprehensive Chinese learning experience, dedicated to cultivating international talents who understand and are friendly towards China. Based on solidifying listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills in Chinese, the curriculum organically integrates rich content on China's national conditions and culture. Our experienced teaching team will guide you in deeply exploring contemporary Chinese society, its developmental vitality, and historical context through language learning. By combining classroom teaching with social practice, you will gain the ability to use Chinese in real-life environments, understand China, enhance your language skills, and form a more comprehensive and profound understanding of the country.
